properties.site-address: Former Valuation Office/Citizen Advice Bureau, Alnwick
properties.notes: Listed building last utilised as offices. Planning permission has been secured for redevelopment of the site to provide 5 apartments through conversion of the grade II listed building, and also of 1 new-build bungalow following a limited amount of demolition (14/01134/FUL). Delivery has commenced and is expected to be finished in 2019/20.
